steps.caption: Open the completed knob kit: a STEP solid with roughing and two finishing operations.
Practise STEP import in a separate empty project; keep the kit job as your reference.
Import knob.step through Import geometry. The solid becomes a CAM part.
Reopen the completed kit job to inspect its saved machining settings.
Inspect the sample GRBL router and the stock-top G54 origin before machining.
Adaptive Rough (3D): 2 mm stepdown, 0.4 diameter stepover, clear all stock.
Parallel Finish (3D): 0.6 mm stepover, 0 deg pass angle, 0.05 mm tolerance.
Waterline Finish (3D): 0.5 mm stepdown, region by region. Inspect cutter reach.
Compute the real roughing and finishing paths in the app, in operation order.
Scrub the knob simulation and inspect the cut before posting.
Post Process: review GRBL, millimetres and the G54 program. Match your controller.
Open the native gear-pair sketches from the kit and inspect their saved CAM operations.
Inspect both setups, stock size and work origins. Confirm your blank placement before machining.
Click Sketch and reopen the first stored parametric gear layer.
Gear tool: inspect teeth, module, pressure angle and root fillet for a variation.
Finish the sketch to return its cutting geometry to CAM.
Inspect Bore 1 and the embedded 3 mm flat end mill; use suitable feeds for your material.
Compute Bore, Pocket and Contour for both setups. The outside profiles have no tabs.
Inspect the first setup simulation; retain each gear with suitable workholding.
Review the GRBL preview. Export separate setup files and check each program's work origin.
Open the kit name sign: outlined lettering, a V-carve and an outside profile.
Inspect the 176 x 68 x 6 mm blank and G54 stock-top origin.
V-Carve uses closed lettering outlines. The shipped SVG needs no installed font.
Tool: 6 mm V-bit, 60 deg included angle; 30 deg on each side of the axis.
Flat depth 1 mm, clear with this bit, 0.3 mm floor stepover, 0.5 mm stepdown.
Outside contour: 3 mm end mill, 0.5 mm stepdown, four 6 x 1.5 mm tabs.
Compute the V-carve before the profile. Narrow strokes and corners vary in depth.
Scrub the sign simulation. Inspect the lettering, retained tabs and outside contour depth.
Review the GRBL program and the V-bit to end-mill tool change before exporting.
